tools.name: about_nexwin
tools.description: Explains what Nexwin is and how to sign up. Use when the user asks what Nexwin is, what it does, or how to get started — no account connection needed.

tools.name: get_bookings
tools.description: Lists the connected Nexwin account's appointments/bookings in a date range (max 30 days, first 25 results). Each booking includes its appointmentId and teamMemberId (needed for reschedule_booking and cancel_booking), exact ISO startTime/endTime, and timezone. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: Lists the connected Nexwin account's active team members with their teamMemberId and timezone. Call this before create_booking to get a real teamMemberId and the timezone to book in. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: get_call_chat_history
tools.description: Lists recent calls or chats for the connected Nexwin account in a date range, without full transcripts. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: get_call_chat_detail
tools.description: Fetches the full transcript and detail for one call or chat, by id. Requires a connected account.

tools.name: get_account_usage_summary
tools.description: Plan, subscription status, minutes/messages used this period, and wallet balance for the connected Nexwin account.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates a new appointment on the connected Nexwin account and emails the customer a confirmation. Executes immediately. Get teamMemberId and timezone from list_team_members first. Online bookings require customerEmail and create a Zoom meeting; in-person bookings need customerEmail or customerPhone.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Moves an existing booking (appointmentId from get_bookings) to a new time and emails the customer about the change. Before calling, tell the user which booking (customer, current time) is moving to which new time, and get their explicit yes; then pass confirm: true. Executes as soon as it is called

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking (appointmentId from get_bookings) by PERMANENTLY DELETING it — it will not appear afterwards, even as canceled. tools.name: get_activity_summary
tools.description: Summarises what happened on the connected Nexwin account over a period: the answer to "what's happened the last two days?" or "anything I need to follow up?". tools.name: find_customer
tools.description: Looks up customers on the connected Nexwin account by part of a name, phone number or email address. Returns contact details, how often they've called or chatted, and what their last conversation was about. Use for "has Sam called before?" or "what did Sam want last time?".

tools.name: get_ai_setup

tools.name: update_ai_setup
tools.description: Changes how the connected account's AI receptionist answers, and puts the change live for real callers straight away. Editable fields: businessName, aboutYourBusiness (max 500 characters), businessAddress, handbook (the How to Handle Calls instructions), assistantName, greetingNew, greetingReturning

tools.name: restore_ai_setup_version
tools.description: Undoes changes made with update_ai_setup or update_service_area by putting those same settings back to what they were in an earlier published version (version numbers come from get_ai_setup or from an update result). Goes live for callers straight away and is itself saved as a new version. Settings

tools.name: update_service_area
tools.description: Changes which places the connected account's AI receptionist serves, and puts the change live for real callers straight away. tools.name: invite_team_member
tools.description: Emails someone an invitation to join the connected Nexwin account with their own login. They become a team member once they accept; the link expires after 24 hours. Use add_team_member instead for a person who only needs to be bookable and won't sign in. The invitee starts with calendar access only;

tools.name: add_team_member
tools.description: Adds a person to the connected Nexwin account's team without a login, so bookings can be made with them. Nobody is emailed. Use invite_team_member instead if they need to sign in. Set isInternalOnly for someone callers should never be told about by name. Returns the new teamMemberId.

tools.name: update_team_member
tools.description: Changes a team member's settings (teamMemberId from list_team_members): their timezone, role, how much notice they need before a booking (leadTimeMinutes), the travel gap kept around each of their bookings (travelBufferMinutes), or whether their name is hidden from callers (isInternalOnly). tools.description: PERMANENTLY removes a team member (teamMemberId from list_team_members) from the connected Nexwin account. tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Lists the bookable assets on the connected Nexwin account: things customers book rather than people, such as hotel rooms, campsites, vehicles or equipment. tools.name: add_assets
tools.description: Adds bookable assets (rooms, campsites, vehicles, equipment) to the connected Nexwin account, up to 100 in one call, and tells the live receptionist about them. tools.description: Adds customers to the connected Nexwin account, up to 200 in one call, from a list the user has pasted or uploaded. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_call_chat_history, get_call_chat_detail, get_account_usage_summary, create_booking, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_activity_summary, get_ai_setup, update_ai_setup, invite_team_member, import_customers · Private data: get_account_usage_summary, find_customer, restore_ai_setup_version · Public sink: find_customer, invite_team_member, import_customers · Destructive: update_ai_setup, update_service_area, remove_team_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_call_chat_history, get_call_chat_detail, get_account_usage_summary, create_booking, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_activity_summary, get_ai_setup, update_ai_setup, invite_team_member, import_customers · Private data: get_account_usage_summary, find_customer, restore_ai_setup_version · Public sink: find_customer, invite_team_member, import_customers · Destructive: update_ai_setup, update_service_area, remove_team_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
